race_window.description: Two threads call recover() on the same OCC_RETRY_WAIT occurrence after a retryable graph failure. Exactly one wins claim_recovery and reopens the pipeline to RUNNING. The loser previously continued past resume() failures other than recovery_claimed (notably not_resumable:running), inspected a still-RUNNING graph, computed graph_ok=False, and settled the deterministic recovered mission as MISSION_FAILED/GRAPH_FAILED. Separately, a loser that returned resume_in_progress with the ORIGINAL mission_id caused recover() to settle the occurrence from the immutable failed source mission; once recovery was RECOVERED (terminal), _graph_retryable became false and finish_occurrence wrote OCC_FAILED. The winner could not overwrite a terminal OCC_FAILED.

reproduction.method: local multi-thread recover with mild stagger; deterministic gated _execute barrier in tests
reproduction.pre_fix_probe: occurrence ended failed while pipeline_state succeeded and recovered mission state failed with GRAPH_FAILED and steps_run=0

not_root_cause: missing uniqueness of recovered mission id (id is already deterministic)
missing recovery claim (claim_recovery is atomic; only one winner)
test assertion alone incorrect — occurrence should succeed when recovery succeeds
